answer.says: You mistake the veil for a mood. It is a condition. I will not drop the cup; I have no intention of staining the grass with the residue of my contemplation.
answer.thought: Sunil's jest is harmless, a small friction in the smooth surface of the morning. He sees the philosopher as an oddity, a foreign body in his routine. I shall ignore the flattery of being called a philosopher and focus on the tombs, which do not care for my reputation or his kerosene stove. The overcast light is actually better for observing the details of the stone; the sharp sun flattens everything into a glare, but the grey brings out the texture and the decay.
